name: voice
description: Talk to Atlas by voice: audio you send is written down, you dictate in the box or anywhere on the computer with a shortcut, Atlas speaks when you ask, and a live voice conversation hands the work to Atlas.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Your OpenAI API key, the one Atlas's OpenAI provider uses: speech is written down, spoken and talked through OpenAI's models. The live conversation costs US$ 0.05 a minute, silence included.

settings.name: transcription_model
settings.description: OpenAI's model that writes down what you say.

settings.name: dictation_shortcut
settings.description: The key that dictates anywhere on the computer: press it to record, press it again to write it where you are. Named as Electron names keys (Capslock, F9, Control+Shift+Space); empty turns it off.

settings.name: speech_model
settings.description: OpenAI's model that speaks Atlas's answers when you ask to hear them.

settings.name: live_model
settings.description: OpenAI's full-duplex voice model of the live conversation.

settings.name: voice
settings.description: The voice that speaks, in the live conversation and in audio answers.

settings.name: voice_turns_model
settings.description: The model that answers what you ask in the live conversation, as provider/model, with no reasoning; "conversation" for the conversation's own model.

settings.name: quiet_close_seconds
settings.description: The live conversation closes after this many seconds of silence, since silence is billed too; 0 never closes it.

settings.name: api_url
settings.description: OpenAI's API address; another one only for a compatible server, or for tests.
